name: IEX_ESSBASE_BALANCES
description: IEX_ESSBASE_BALANCES table stores information about the receivable transactions, receipts and adjustments.This table is used to temporarily store the data and populate the same into essbase cube for calculation of various metrics.

columns.name: IEX_ESSBASE_BALANCES_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of this essbase balance table.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.description: The type of Document which is populated from the lookup_type  AR_DOCUMENT_TYPE.This maps to Document Type dimension in the cube.

columns.name: TRX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Invoice, debit memo, credit memo and chargeback amount in functional currency. Deposits and Guarantees are excluded.

columns.name: RECEIPT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Receipt application, unapplication or reversal amount in functional currency.

columns.name: ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Adjustment amount in functional currency.

columns.name: PROMISE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Promise to pay in functional currency.

columns.name: NSF_AMOUNT
columns.description: Non Sufficient Fund amount in functional currency.

columns.name: TRX_AMOUNT_GLOBAL
columns.description: Invoice or Debit Memo or Credit Memo or Charge Back amount in global currency. Deposits and Guarantees are excluded.

columns.name: RECEIPT_AMOUNT_GLOBAL
columns.description: The receipt application, unapplication or reversal amount in global currency.

columns.name: ADJ_AMOUNT_GLOBAL
columns.description: Adjustment amount in global currency.

columns.name: PROMISE_AMOUNT_GLOBAL
columns.description: Promise to pay in global currency.

columns.name: NSF_AMOUNT_GLOBAL
columns.description: Non Sufficient Fund amount in global currency.

columns.name: SCORE
columns.description: The object score for a party, account, or bill to customer.

columns.name: AVERAGE_TERMS
columns.description: The product of relative amount and due days from RA_TERMS_LINES used for calculation of weighted average terms metric.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_DATE
columns.description: The transaction date for Invoice or Debit Memo or Credit Memo or Chargeback, Application and unapplication or reversal date for receipts and adjsutment application date for adjustments. This maps to time dimension in the cube.

columns.name: PS_DUE_DATE
columns.description: Due date from PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID is populated for document type invoice, chargeback, debit memos, and credit memos  For document type receipt, due date column contains the due date of the payment_schedule _id to which receipt is applied,unapplied or reversed. In case of adjustments this column stores the due date of the of payment_schedule_id being adjusted.

columns.name: PS_CLOSED_DATE
columns.description: GL_CLOSED_DATE from payment schedules is populated for the object type invoices. For open invoices the close date is null.

columns.name: CURRENCY
columns.description: The functional currency which is dervied from the ledger to which business unit is associated with. This maps to currency dimension in the cube.

columns.name: BU_NAME
columns.description: The business unit name is stored.This maps to business unit dimension in the cube.

columns.name: PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the party from HZ_PARTIES. This maps to customer dimension in the cube.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: The account number conctenated with party name  from HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS Table is stored. This forms the part of customer dimension hierarchy in the cube.

columns.name: PARTY_SITE_NAME
columns.description: The party site name concatenated with party name and account number from HZ_PARTY_SITES table is stored. This forms the part of customer dimension hierarchy in the cube.

columns.name: COLLECTOR_NAME
columns.description: Collector Name associated in profile tab at business level. This maps to  Collector dimension in the cube.

columns.name: SALESREP_NAME
columns.description: Sales Representative Name. This maps to Sales Representative dimension in the cube.

columns.name: COUNTRY
columns.description: Country from HZ_LOCATIONS. This is part of location dimension hierarchy in the cube.

columns.name: STATE
columns.description: State Code from HZ_LOCATIONS. This is part of location dimension hierarchy in the cube.

columns.name: COUNTY
columns.description: County from HZ_LOCATIONS. This is part of location dimension hierarchy in the cube.

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: City from HZ_LOCATIONS. This is part of location dimension hierarchy in the cube.

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Zip Code from HZ_LOCATIONS. This is part of location dimension hierarchy in the cube.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: Location concatenated with LOCATION_ID from  HZ_LOCATIONS is stored in this column. This will be part of location hierarchy in the cube.

columns.name: PROFILE_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Profile classification from HZ_CUST_PROFILE_CLASSES.

columns.name: AGING_BUCKET_NAME
columns.description: The aging bucket information popluated from the lookup_type IEX_AGING_BUCKETS.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES.PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
